status: frozen before v3 generation and unchanged regression plus fresh confirmation leakage audits
noise_definition: One global Brownian bridge per parent, zero only at chart endpoints. At every severity, perturb log close by severity times the clean log-price range times the same maximum-absolute-one bridge. Major pivots and completion may become obscured at high noise. All variants retain their source-family label.

framing_control.method: Time-axis interpolation of the same OHLCV template and noise realization. This holds bar count constant; it is not a new historical window.

definitions.Head and Shoulders: Three peaks; middle highest. Shoulders vary from 0.60 through 0.83 in normalized latent log-price units, with asymmetry at most 0.03; neckline troughs vary from 0.18 through 0.35 with a small random tilt. Pivot timing varies. Final clean prices and the independent margin remain below the neckline.
definitions.Inverse Head and Shoulders: Inverse construction in latent log-price space: three troughs, deepest in the middle, comparable outer troughs and a final upward neckline break.
definitions.Double Top: Two similar peaks (latent difference<=0.03), a substantial randomized trough, variable durations, then a break below the trough.
definitions.Double Bottom: Inverse Double Top construction: two similar troughs, a substantial intervening peak, then an upward break.
definitions.Triangle: Symmetric/ascending/descending alternating bounds converge, with randomized heights and pivot timing. Clean final segment crosses outside the last bound.
definitions.Bull Flag: Steep positive pole, smaller downward roughly parallel channel with varied width/slope/timing, then an upward break above the pole.
definitions.None: Screened stochastic random walks, choppy ranges, trends with random pullbacks, incomplete formations, and structurally broken reversals/consolidations. All use the same nuisance distributions, clean log-return volatility distribution, baseline microtexture and OHLCV style as positives.

interpretation: Labels identify source geometry, not guaranteed visual class after corruption. This balanced constructed recognition set is not market prevalence or predictive evidence. None screening is conservative; image-level incidental patterns remain possible.
mirror: Horizontal flipping reverses time; it does not exchange Head and Shoulders with Inverse, or Double Top with Double Bottom. Only vertical price inversion creates those counterparts.
clean_definition: Clean means no added corruption. Every clean parent includes a shared daily AR(1), rho 0.45, microtexture projected to zero at source knots and normalized globally, plus stochastic opening gaps and wicks. None source paths are themselves stochastic.

nuisance_distributions.bars: Discrete uniform 60 through 120 for all classes
nuisance_distributions.clean_log_return_std: Log-uniform 0.004 through 0.018, imposed exactly (sample ddof=1) for every parent
nuisance_distributions.microtexture_fraction_of_latent_range: Uniform 0.035 through 0.11; common AR(1) daily process projected to zero at source knots for all classes, normalized globally
nuisance_distributions.wick_scale_fraction_of_target_vol: Uniform 0.12 through 0.40, with per-bar lognormal multipliers
nuisance_distributions.volume_logstd: Uniform 0.12 through 0.35; volume independent of geometry and colored neutral gray
nuisance_distributions.lead_in_and_out: Independent signed endpoint displacements, uniform -0.14 through 0.14 source range, plus bridge amplitude 0.015 through 0.06; bounded to 0.16 range and independent of class/pattern direction
nuisance_distributions.padding: Uniform among integer left/right padding pairs, each 10 through 20 percent of pattern span
nuisance_distributions.pivot_durations: Class geometry interval proportions jittered independently by uniform 0.65 through 1.35 multipliers, then normalized

none_screen: Reject source control paths with an obvious completed whole-window H&S/inverse, double top/bottom, converging triangle or valid pole/down-channel/up-break flag. Frozen geometric tolerances only; no classifier-based acceptance. Screen operates synthetic source knots, not noisy images or real data. Stochastic paths and hard negatives can still have incidental local or ambiguous shapes.
leakage_audit: A separate cohort of fresh parent seeds may be fitted only to diagnose generator leakage. Primary evaluation parents and their variants remain evaluation-only. After the failed v2 audit, the explicit v3 negative mixture was frozen before rerunning unchanged classifiers on regression seed 20261017/split 1701 plus a predeclared fresh confirmation seed 20261023/split 2301. Both balanced-accuracy gates remain strictly below 0.90; failed prior results are retained.
sample_selection: Noise grid: first parent of each class at levels 0, 0.08, 0.55. Diversity grid: first three parents per positive class; first six None parents, one per source family, in two rows.
none_mixture: Six equally cycled source families, fixed for coverage of plausible negatives rather than a classifier score. With 28 primary None parents the first four families have 5 each and the last two have 4 each. The three stochastic families remain; three geometric hard-negative families add incomplete and structurally invalid formations.

none_hard_negative_rules.incomplete_formation: Draw one of the six positive source families, retain its principal geometry but end without the required confirmed break. Triangle endpoints remain inside a still-converging envelope; an unconfirmed flag can exceed its channel but stays below its pole high. Independent margins remain too small to confirm a break.
none_hard_negative_rules.broken_reversal: Three comparable peaks/troughs (triple top/bottom outside the taxonomy) or clearly unequal double peaks/troughs. These may finish with completed-looking downward/upward exits; source geometry violates the target definition.
none_hard_negative_rules.broken_consolidation: Expanding upper/lower bounds rather than a converging triangle, or an upward-sloping parallel consolidation after a positive pole rather than the required downward flag. These may finish with an outward/upward exit, so lack of completion is not the only negative cue.

development_note: Before v3 classifier evaluation, geometric review replaced a reversed-pole negative with a rising consolidation: a reversed initial pole could create a new positive pole on its rebound. This correctness fix was made without v3 classifier feedback.
